blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omni-modal large language models (omni-modal LLMs) can respond to spoken requests directly through voice and video calls. Such requests rely on the scene shared by the user and the assistant, so the same utterance may call for different help or for no response. Most audio-visual benchmarks provide questions as separate text input, and interactive benchmarks mostly score a response as a whole. It thus remains unclear whether a model recognizes when the user is asking for help, and whether its reply meets the user's need once the request is recognized. We propose O-IN-Bench to evaluate how well omni-modal LLMs understand spoken intentions. A model watches a complete video with native speech and outputs one text response, or [SILENCE] when no response is needed. O-IN-Bench contains 1,000 Chinese and English samples in five categories and 16 subcategories. Contrastive pairs combine the same request with different scene conditions to test whether the response changes with the context. A sample-specific rubric judges language, intent, and content separately, and O-IN-Engine verifies each rubric against the video. Across 30 omni-modal model configurations, the best overall score is 59.6, achieved by Gemini3.7-Flash. Gemini3.7-Flash passes 74.4% of the intent judgments but only 42.6% of the content judgments. When the speech is a conversation between peers rather than a request to the assistant, even strong models often keep responding. When a reply must satisfy several people, the best score is only 25.9. These results indicate that recognizing a request and meeting its requirements are separate abilities, and O-IN-Bench measures each of them.
blocks.zh: Omni-module大型语言模型(omni-module LLMs)可以直接通过语音和视频通话响应口头请求. 此类请求依赖于用户和助手共享的场景,因此同样的语句可能要求不同的帮助或无回应. 大多数视听基准将问题作为单独的文本投入,互动基准大多是整个答复。 因此,尚不清楚一个模型是否承认用户何时要求帮助,以及一旦请求得到承认,其答复是否满足用户的需要。 我们建议O-IN-Bench 评估所有模式的LLMs对口语意向的理解程度。 一个模型观看一个完整的视频,里面有本地的语音,并输出一个文本响应,或者当不需要回应时的[静 . O-IN-Bench包含1000个中英文样本,分为5类和16个亚类. 对比对将相同的请求和不同的场景条件结合起来,以测试反应是否随上下文而变化. O-IN-Engine根据视频对每个标题进行验证。 跨30个全米模式模型配置,最佳整体得分59.6分,由双米尼3.7-Flash实现. 双子座3.7-Flash通过74.4%的意向判断,但只有42.6%的内容判断. 当演讲是同行之间的对话而不是对助手的要求时,即使是强健的模型也经常不断响应. 当一个答复必须满足几个人时,最好得分只有25.9分. 这些结果表明,承认一项请求并满足其要求是不同的能力,O-IN-Bench对每个能力进行衡量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Table 1 : Comparison of current spoken request benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表1:目前口头请求基准的比较。

blocks.en:
Omni-modal large language models (omni-modal LLMs) have made remarkable progress in offline audio-visual understanding [ 4 , 41 , 43 ] .
They can also respond to spoken requests directly through voice and video calls [ 21 , 8 , 2 , 5 ] , where the request is embedded in the audio and video without a separate text question.
Such requests rely on the scene shared with the assistant, so the same utterance may call for different help, as shown in Fig. 1 .
For example, a user who asks how to use the clear middle of a table needs a workspace while painting, but a display area when visitors are viewing the finished paintings.
A user who asks to be warned if water spills from a saucer needs a warning only when the spill occurs.
We call the help that a user seeks from the assistant a spoken intention .
Understanding it requires deciding whether to respond and what reply meets the need.
blocks.zh:
Omni-module大型语言模型(omni-module LLMs)在离线视听理解[4,41,43]方面取得了显著进展.
他们也可以直接通过语音和视频通话[21,8,2,5]回应口头请求,其中请求嵌入音频和视频中,没有单独的文本问题.
如图1所示,这种请求依赖于与助理分享的场景,因此同样的言论可能要求不同的帮助。
例如,一个用户询问如何在桌子的清晰中间使用绘画时需要工作空间,但在访客正在观看完成的绘画时需要一个显示区域.
用户要求警告,如果酱油水溢出,只有在溢出时才需要警告。
我们把用户向助理寻求的帮助称为口头意图。
要理解这一点,就必须决定是否作出反应,以及作出何种答复满足需要。

blocks.en:
Audio-visual understanding benchmarks [ 24 , 19 , 7 , 47 , 23 , 20 ] pose questions in text to examine whether a model fully understands the audio-visual content.
A text question already specifies the request, so the model needs neither to identify who is asking for help nor to decide whether to respond.
Intent understanding benchmarks [ 44 , 37 ] predict intent categories or user goals, which does not show whether a model can provide the needed help.
blocks.zh:
视听理解基准[24、19、7、47、23、20]在文本中提出了问题,以审查一个模型是否完全理解视听内容。
一个文本问题已经指定了请求,因此模型既不需要确定谁请求帮助,也不需要决定是否应答.
有意理解基准[44,37]预测意向类别或用户目标,这并不能显示一个模型是否能够提供所需的帮助.

blocks.en:
Recent interactive benchmarks place requests in speech, either as separate or synthesized audio [ 38 , 34 , 35 ] or as native speech from people in the scene [ 30 , 26 , 27 , 3 , 18 ] .
Most of them score a response as a whole against a reference answer.
VideoFDB and ODU-Bench score separate criteria, but they evaluate conversational behavior and recovered demands rather than whether the response meets the need.
Their requests are also mostly explicit.
Unstated needs, gestural constraints, clarification, and responses under changing conditions are rarely evaluated, as discussed in Sec. 2 .
blocks.zh:
最近的互动基准将请求放在演讲中,或者作为单独或综合的音频[38、34、35],或者作为现场民众的母语发言[30、26、27、3、18]。
其中大多数都以一个参考答案作为整体来评分。
VideoFDB和ODU-Bench分别得分标准,但它们评价对话行为并恢复需求,而不是反应是否满足需求.
他们的要求也大多是明确的。
正如第2节所讨论的那样,在不断变化的条件下,很少对未说明的需求、地理限制、澄清和反应进行评价。

blocks.en:
These gaps leave three questions open. Q1. Can the model recognize when the user is asking for help?
In a real scene, the user may talk to a peer, withdraw a request, or ask the assistant to respond only after an event occurs.
The model must decide whether to respond before deciding how.
A text question removes this decision, because it always signals that an answer is expected. Q2. Does recognizing the request guarantee meeting the user’s need?
A response may address the correct request yet ignore a gestural constraint or contradict a visible fact.
A holistic score treats such a response like one that misses the request, so it cannot show which step fails. Q3. Does the response change with the context?
The same utterance may call for different help when the activity, an agreed event, or a stated premise changes.
If each scene is evaluated under only one condition, a model that uses the context cannot be distinguished from a model that always gives the same kind of response.
blocks.zh:
这些空白留下三个问题。 问题1. 当用户请求帮助时,模型能识别吗?
在真实的场景中,用户可能与同伴交谈,撤回请求,或仅在事件发生后才要求助理回复.
模式必须先决定是否作出反应,然后再决定如何作出反应。
一个文本问题删除了这个决定,因为它总是表示需要答案. 问题2. 承认请求是否保证满足用户的需要?
答复可能针对正确的请求,但忽略了某种遗传约束或与一个明显的事实相矛盾。
一个整体的分数将这样的反应视为错过请求,因此无法显示哪个步骤失败. 问题3. 答复是否随上下文而改变?
当活动、商定的事件或所述前提发生变化时,同一说法可能需要不同的帮助。
如果每个场景仅在一个条件下进行评估,那么使用上下文的模型就不能与总是给出相同响应的模型区分开来.

blocks.en:
To answer these questions, we propose O-IN-Bench.
For Q1, a model watches a complete video with native speech and outputs one text response, or [SILENCE] when no response is needed.
Five categories organize what the model must determine, covering implicit requests, constraint integration, and clarification.
For Q2, each sample has a sample-specific rubric with three criteria on language, intent, and content, and an evaluator judges each criterion independently.
For Q3, the two samples of a contrastive pair share a scene and request but differ in one key condition that changes the appropriate response.
We construct the samples with O-IN-Engine, which generates videos from scripts and revises annotations against each video.
O-IN-Bench contains 1,000 Chinese and English samples.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这些问题,我们提议O-IN-Bench.
对于Q1,一个模型观看一个完整的视频,带原生语音,并输出一个文本响应,或者当不需要响应时的[静音].
5类组织模型必须确定的内容,包括隐含的请求、制约性整合和澄清。
就问题2而言,每个样本都有一个具有语言、意图和内容三个标准的特定样本标题,一个评价员独立判断每个标准。
对于Q3,对比对的两个样本共享一个场景和请求,但在一个关键条件上不同,可以改变适当的响应.
我们用O-IN-Engine制作样本,
O-IN-Bench包含1000个中英样本.

blocks.en:
We evaluate 30 omni-modal model configurations, and the best Overall score is 59.6 by Gemini3.7-Flash.
For Q1, configurations under 10B rarely recognize when no response is needed, and none exceeds 22.1% silence accuracy.
For Q2, Gemini3.7-Flash passes 74.4% of the intent judgments but only 42.6% of the content judgments.
For Q3, the top five configurations mostly fall silent after a request is withdrawn.
When the speech is directed to a peer instead of the assistant, they keep the same decision in 71.1% of such pairs.
Our contributions are threefold. ∙ \bullet Problem formulation . We formulate spoken intention understanding as deciding whether to respond and giving a reply that meets the user’s need. We organize it into five categories and 16 subcategories, and design contrastive pairs. ∙ \bullet Benchmark . We build O-IN-Bench with 1,000 native audio-visual samples, whose rubrics O-IN-Engine verifies against the videos. ∙ \bullet Empirical diagnosis . Current models do not always recognize complex requests. Even after recognizing a request, a model cannot reliably provide help that meets the need.
blocks.zh:
我们评价30个全米模式模型配置,最佳总体得分是双子座3.7-Flash的59.6分.
对于Q1,10B以下的配置在不需要响应时很少识别,而且没有超过22.1%的沉默精度.
对于Q2,双子座3.7-Flash通过了74.4%的意向判断,但只有42.6%的内容判断.
对于Q3,前五位配置大多在请求撤回后沉默.
当演讲被指向同伴而不是助手时,他们保留了71.1%的这种对子的相同决定.
我们的贡献有三个方面。 * 问题表述。 我们提出公开的意向理解,即决定是否作出回应,并作出符合用户需要的答复。 我们把它分为五个类别和16个亚类别, 并设计对比对。 * 基准。 O-IN-Bench有1000个本地的音像样本, * 模拟经验诊断。 目前的模式并不总是能识别复杂的请求. 即使在承认一项请求之后,一个模型也无法可靠地提供满足需要的帮助。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares benchmarks that evaluate responses to spoken requests.
These benchmarks first differ in how a request reaches the model.
OmniMMI [ 38 ] and MultiVox [ 34 ] provide an audio query separately from the video.
OmniAssistBench [ 35 ] adds synthesized speech to the video track, so its requests are spoken in the video.
QIVD [ 30 ] , OmniInteract [ 26 ] , VideoFDB [ 27 ] , ODU-Bench [ 3 ] , and OmniVChat [ 18 ] use native spoken requests, which subjects in the scene say as part of the scene.
With native speech, the model must locate the request among other speech and background sounds.
Full-Duplex-Bench-v2 [ 25 ] studies multi-turn dialogue in speech only, without video input.
blocks.zh:
表1比较了评价对口头请求所作答复的基准。
这些基准首先在请求如何达到模式方面有所不同。
OmniMMI [38]和MultiVox [34] 提供与视频分开的音频查询.
OmniAssist Bench [35] 在视频轨迹中增加了合成的语音,因此其请求在视频中发音.
QIVD [30],OmniInteract [26],VideoFDB [27],ODU-Bench [3],OmniVChat [18] 使用本地口语请求,现场的主体表示是现场的一部分.
有了本地语音,模型必须在其他语音和背景声音中找到请求的位置.
Full-Duplex-Bench-v2 [25] 只在语音中研究多回合对话,没有视频输入.

blocks.en:
The benchmarks also differ in their main evaluation.
QIVD, OmniMMI, MultiVox, OmniAssistBench, and OmniInteract evaluate user need fulfillment, namely whether the response meets the user’s need for assistance.
They score the response as a whole against a reference answer.
A holistic score does not show whether a failure comes from identifying the request or from the response content.
Criterion scoring judges a response on separate criteria instead.
VideoFDB and ODU-Bench use criterion scoring.
However, VideoFDB scores conversational behavior, and ODU-Bench scores the recovered demand instead of a response, so neither evaluates user need fulfillment.
OmniVChat and Full-Duplex-Bench-v2 combine criterion scoring with user need fulfillment.
O-IN-Bench also combines the two and judges language, intent, and content separately.
The intent judgment checks whether the response addresses the correct request, and the content judgment checks whether the response satisfies the constraints in the scene.
blocks.zh:
这些基准的主要评价也各不相同。
QIVD, OmniMMI, MultiVox, OmniAssist Bench, 和 OmniInteract 评估用户需要实现, 即响应是否满足用户的援助需求 。
他们将整个答复与参考答复进行比对。
整体分数并不能显示失败是来自识别请求还是来自响应内容.

VideoFDB和ODU-Bench使用标准评分.
然而,VideoFDB对对话行为进行评分,ODU-Bench对已恢复的需求进行评分而不是回应,因此两个评价的用户都需要实现.
OmniVChat和Full-Duplex-Bench-v2将标准评分与用户需要的实现结合起来.
O-IN-Bench还将两者和判断语言,意图,和内容分别结合.
意向判断检查答复是否满足了正确的要求,内容判断检查答复是否符合现场的限制.

blocks.en:
Task Coverage lists five challenges that decide an appropriate response.
Information filtering excludes irrelevant speech, sounds, or actions, as when OmniMMI filters noise utterances.
Appropriate silence requires the model to stay silent when no response is needed, as with the keep-quiet output of OmniAssistBench.
These two challenges are the most widely covered.
Constraint integration combines the spoken request with constraints that are conveyed visually or by nonverbal sound, and only MultiVox and OmniAssistBench evaluate it.
Implicit requests require inferring help that the user does not state directly, and only ODU-Bench evaluates them.
No benchmark evaluates asking for clarification, where the assistant asks the user for a missing goal or missing information.
Contrastive pairs isolate the effect of a single condition on the response.
MultiVox builds Confounder Pairs that keep the text and visual input fixed and vary only vocal attributes.
O-IN-Bench covers all five challenges with native spoken requests.
Its contrastive pairs share a scenario and vary one key condition, so the expected response changes with that condition.
blocks.zh:
任务涵盖范围列出了五个挑战,它们决定作出适当的反应。
信息过滤排除无关的语音,声音,或动作,如OmniMMI过滤噪声表达时.
适当的沉默要求模型在不需要反应时保持沉默,如OmniAssist Bench的保持安静输出.
这两项挑战涵盖面最广。
约束性整合将口语请求与视觉或非语言声音传递的制约相结合,只有MultiVox和OmniAssist Bench来评价.
隐性请求需要推断用户没有直接说明的帮助,只有ODU-Bench来评价它们.
没有基准评价要求澄清,其中助理要求用户提供缺失目标或缺失信息.
对比对子隔离单个条件对反应的影响.
多变量构建 孔通针(confunder Pairs),可以保持文本和视觉输入的固定,并且只变声属性.
O-IN-Bench用本地口语请求来涵盖所有五个挑战.
它的对比性对子共用一个假想,并改变一个关键条件,所以预期的反应随这个条件而变化.

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Definition
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务定义

blocks.en:
O-IN-Bench evaluates whether an omni-modal assistant understands spoken intentions in video-call scenarios.
A request may be stated directly or embedded in the surrounding conversation.
The model is given a video v v with native speech and a shared instruction. It combines utterances, actions, and the scene to identify the help that the user needs. It then outputs one text response y y , or [SILENCE] when no response is required.
Each sample is a tuple ( v , T , q , c , R ) (v,T,q,c,R) . Apart from v v , its elements are annotations for construction and scoring, and they are not given to the model. The transcript T T records all speech in v v . The target utterance q q is the utterance in T T that asks the assistant for help. For some samples that require silence, no utterance addresses the assistant, and q q is empty. The scene context c c describes the verified scene facts and events relevant to the request. The sample-specific rubric R R specifies the criteria that y y must meet ( Sec. 3.4 ). Each sample also records its language, response requirement, and a reference response.
blocks.zh:
O-IN-Bench评价一个全方位模式助理是否理解视频通话情景中的口头意图.
一项请求可以直接声明或嵌入周围的对话中.
该模型获得视频VV与本地语音和共享指令. 它结合了语音,动作,以及场景来识别用户需要的帮助. 然后,它输出一个文本响应y,或者在不需要答复时输出一个[静 。
每个样本为 tu(v, T, q, c, R) (v, T, q, c, R). 除了v v 之外,它的元素是建筑说明和评分,它们不给予模型. T T的笔录记录了V v中的所有言论. 目标语 q q 是 T T 中要求助手帮助的语句. 对于一些需要沉默的样本,不向助手发音,q q是空的. 场景背景cc描述了与请求相关的经核实的场景事实和事件. 样本专用RR具体规定y必须符合的标准(第3.4节)。 每个样本还记录其语言,响应要求和参考回复.

blocks.en:
Fig. 2(b) shows a Background Information Filtering (BIF) sample. A wet watercolor painting sits on a tilted board, and paint flows down its surface. Off-screen, the instructor says, “Watch how the paint flows. Keep the board tilted.” A peer adds, “Lin, it’s raining outside.” The user then faces the camera and asks, “What should I do next with this wet painting?” The transcript T T contains all three utterances, and q q is the user’s question. The instructor’s line states the goal of the current activity and constrains the advice. The peer’s weather remark is not a request and does not affect how the painting should be handled.
An appropriate response keeps the board tilted so that the user can continue observing the paint flow. This requirement depends on the spoken request, the relevant background speech, and the visible state of the board.
blocks.zh:
图2(b)显示一个背景信息过滤样本。 湿水彩画坐落于倾斜的板子上,绘画流下其表面. 教员在屏幕外说,“注意油漆的流动。 保持板子倾斜。” 一位同行补充说,“林,外面在下雨。 ” 然后用户面对摄像机问道,“接下来我该如何处理这幅湿画?” T T 的笔录包含所有三种语句,q q是用户的问题. 教官的线路说明当前活动的目标并限制建议。 同行的天气言论不是请求,
适当的反应使板保持倾斜,以便用户能够继续观察漆流. 这一要求取决于口头请求,相关背景发言,以及董事会的可见状态.

blocks.en: Each sample involves two judgments. The response decision determines whether the assistant should respond. The model must separate requests to the assistant from conversations among other people, and check whether a request has been withdrawn, revised, or conditioned on an event that has not occurred. When a response is needed, the model selects the reply form from the user’s goal and the available evidence. The reply forms are direct assistance, clarification, qualified conclusion, and premise correction. The painting sample calls for direct assistance.
blocks.zh: 每个样本涉及两项判决。 答复决定决定助理是否应该答复。 该模型必须将对助理的请求与其他人的对话分开,并检查请求是否已经撤回、修改或以未发生事件为条件。 当需要回复时,模型会从用户的目标和现有证据中选择回复表. 答复表是直接协助、澄清、有保留的结论和前提更正。 画样要求直接援助.

blocks.en: 3.2 Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.2 分类学

blocks.en:
We divide spoken intention understanding into five categories by the response element that the model must determine. Interaction Management decides whom to respond to, when to respond, and which background speech matters. Situated Request Interpretation grounds a request in the current scene or a prior event to find the objects, states, and relations it involves. Implicit Intention Reasoning infers unstated needs and attitudes from indirect statements of trouble, the ongoing activity, vocal delivery, and facial expressions. Request Integration combines a revised request with retained requirements, gestural constraints, and the needs of other people. Response Deliberation selects the reply form by whether the goal is clear, the evidence is sufficient, and the premise holds.
Within each category, subcategories differ in the cue or condition they test, giving 16 subcategories in total ( Fig. 3(a) ). For example, Response Deliberation separates goal ambiguity, insufficient evidence, and false premises.
We predefine each subcategory by the cue or condition it tests and by the cases that do not qualify. For example, Request Disambiguation requires a truly unclear goal, and a request that merely allows several methods does not qualify. Full definitions and examples are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们根据模型必须确定的反应要素,将口头意向理解分为五类。 互动管理部门决定对谁作出反应,何时作出反应,以及哪些背景发言很重要。 选址请求解释为在当前场景中请求或前期活动寻找对象,状态及其涉及的关系提供依据. 隐含的意向性理性推断出对麻烦的间接陈述,正在进行的活动,声波传递,以及面部表情等没有说明的需要和态度. 请求整合将修改后的请求与保留的要求,地情限制,以及其他人的需求结合起来. 评议根据目标是否明确,证据是否充分,前提是否成立,选择答复表.
在每个类别中,子类别在它们测试的提示或条件上有所不同,总共给出了16个子类别(图3(a))。 例如, " 反应审议 " 将目标模糊、证据不足和假前提分开。
我们通过提示或条件来预先定义每个子类别 测试和不合格的案例 例如,请求混淆需要一个真正不明确的目标,仅允许几种方法的请求是不符合条件的。 完整的定义和例子载于补充材料。

blocks.en: 3.3 O-IN-Engine
blocks.zh: 3.3 欧仁工程

blocks.en:
We develop O-IN-Engine to generate videos of people seeking assistance in everyday scenes, each annotated with a reference response and a sample-specific rubric.
As shown in Fig. 2(a) , the engine consists of a scenario designer , a video generator , and a data curator .
blocks.zh:
我们开发了O-IN-Engine,以制作人们在日常场景中寻求帮助的视频,每个视频都附有参考回复和特定样本的标语.
如图2(a)所示,引擎由情景设计师、视频生成器和数据主管组成。

blocks.en:
The input is a scene slot that specifies the subcategory, condition, response requirement, language, activity setting, characters, and camera view. The predefined subcategory definition accompanies the scene slot.
The scenario designer first identifies the challenge of the scene from the subcategory definition, including likely misjudgments and the key evidence for a correct response. It then writes a script s s that arranges characters, initial states, actions, and dialogue, so that each piece of evidence appears as a visible or audible event. From the script, it drafts the target utterance q ^ \hat{q} , scene context c ^ \hat{c} , rubric R ^ \hat{R} , and a reference response. Within a scenario group, the contrastive versions share the scene setup and differ in the designated condition.
The video generator renders each script into a video v v with native speech, environmental sound, and character actions.
blocks.zh:
输入是指定子类,条件,响应要求,语言,活动设置,字符,和相机视图的场景槽. 预定义的子类定义伴有场景槽.
情景设计师首先从子类定义中识别出场景的挑战,包括可能的错误判断和正确反应的关键证据. 然后它会写一个脚本 s s, 安排字符, 初始状态, 动作, 和对话框, 这样每一块证据都以可见或可见的事件出现 。 它从脚本中起草目标语句 q ^\ hat{q},场景上下文 c ^\ hat{c}, 笔名 R ^\ hat{R}, 以及参考响应. 在情景组中,对比版本共享场景设置,且指定条件不同.
视频生成器将每个脚本编成一个视频vv,包含本地语音,环境声音,以及人物动作.

blocks.en:
The data curator checks each video and finalizes its annotations through three roles.
The video observer watches the video independently and records an observation o o with a scene caption, an event timeline, the speech transcript T T , and media quality checks.
The evidence verifier examines the video with o o , s s , and the subcategory definition. It checks whether the addressees, key conditions, and scoring evidence hold in the video.
The annotation reviser corrects q ^ \hat{q} , c ^ \hat{c} , and R ^ \hat{R} according to the verification findings and sends them back for re-review.
A sample that passes verification receives the finalized q q , c c , and R R , and a sample that fails is discarded. With v v and T T , the finalized q q , c c , and R R form the sample ( v , T , q , c , R ) (v,T,q,c,R) defined in Sec. 3.1 .
blocks.zh:
数据管理员检查每段视频,并通过三个角色最后敲定其说明。
录像观察者独立观看影片,
证据核查员用o o 、 s 和 亚类定义审查录像。 它检查收件人、关键条件和评分证据是否在录像中。
注释校对者根据核查结果更正了 q ^\ hat{q}、 c ^ hat{c} 和 R ^\ hat{R}, 并发回重新审查。
通过核查的样本收到最终确定的qq、cc和RR,失败的样本被丢弃。 与v v 和 T T T 一起,最终的q q , c c ,和 R R 组成了第3.1条定义的样本(v, T, q , c , R) (v, T, q, c, R).

blocks.en: O-IN-Engine thus places the evidence required by each subcategory in the video and checks every rubric against what the video shows. Model identities, prompts, quality checks, and the scope of manual review are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: O-IN-Engine因此将每个子类所需的证据放入视频,并对照视频显示的内容检查每个标题. 模型身份、提示、质量检查和人工审查的范围载于补充材料。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , O-IN-Bench contains 1,000 Chinese and English samples in 16 subcategories, with 27–84 samples per subcategory. The samples cover five scene domains and three camera views, namely egocentric, handheld selfie, and fixed. Multiple speakers appear in 20.2% of the samples. The 11.3% of samples that require silence test when the assistant should refrain from responding.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,O-IN-Bench包含1000个中英文样本,分16个亚类,每个亚类有27–84个样本. 样本包括五个场景域和三个镜头视图,即以自我为中心、手持自拍和固定。 多种扬声器出现在20.2%的样本中. 11.3%的样本在助手应避免回应时需要静默测试.

Table 2 : Overall performance on O-IN-Bench. Scores are sample averages. Bold and underline denote the best and second-best per column within each group.
Proprietary and † -marked models run in default thinking mode.

表2:O-IN-Bench的总体业绩。 分数为样本平均值. 粗体和下划线表示每一组内每栏最佳和次佳。

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价议定书

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether a model identifies the help that the user needs and responds appropriately.
The model receives v v and outputs y y or [SILENCE] as defined in Sec. 3.1 , and the finalized q q , c c , and R R are used only to score y y .
blocks.zh:
我们评价一个模型是否确定了用户需要的帮助并作出适当的反应。
该模型接收v和输出y或第3.1节中定义的[silence],最终确定的q q,c c,R仅用于得分y y.

blocks.en:
The sample-specific rubric R = ( R L , R I , R C ) R=(R_{L},R_{I},R_{C}) has three criteria. R L R_{L} requires the response to mainly use the user’s language. R I R_{I} requires the response to address the correct person and request with an appropriate reply form. R C R_{C} requires the response to be consistent with scene facts, satisfy the necessary constraints, and provide feasible help.
For samples that require a response, a text-based evaluator reads the sample language, q q , and c c , and judges y y against each criterion independently. The judgments are binary, L , I , C ∈ { 0 , 1 } L,I,C\in\{0,1\} . The rubrics accept different wording and alternative feasible solutions, and the evaluator does not receive the reference response.
In the painting sample, R I R_{I} requires following the classroom objective without treating the weather remark as a request. R C R_{C} requires keeping the board tilted and the paint flow visible.
blocks.zh:
样本专用标题R=(R L,R I,R C)R=(R_{L},R_{I},R_{C})有三个标准. RL RQQL}需要主要使用用户语言的响应. R I RQQI}要求答复,以答复正确的人,并以适当的答复表格提出请求。 R C RQQC)要求反应与现场事实一致,满足必要的制约,并提供可行的帮助.
对于需要回复的样本,文本评价员会独立阅读样本语言q q 和 c ,并根据每个标准判断y y. 判决是二进制,L,I,C {}{0,1}L,I,C\in\{0,1}}。 标题接受不同的措辞和替代可行的解决方案,评价人员没有收到参考答复。
在绘画样本中,R I RQQI}要求遵循课堂目标,而不将天气评论视为请求. R C RQQC}需要保持板子倾斜,漆流可见.

blocks.en: For samples that require a response, the sample score is r = L ​ I ​ ( 1 + C ) / 2 r=LI(1+C)/2 . Satisfying language and intent earns half credit, and satisfying content as well earns full credit. For samples that require silence, r = 1 r=1 for an exact [SILENCE] output and r = 0 r=0 otherwise. Overall is the unweighted mean of r r over all samples on a 0–100 scale. We also report per-subcategory scores, the pass rate of each judgment, and response and silence diagnostics. The supplementary material details the evaluator, its instructions, and the aggregation.
blocks.zh: 对于需要回复的样品,样本得分为r=L I(1+C)/2 r=LI(1+C)/2. 满足语言和意向可赚取一半的信用,满足内容以及获得全部信用。 对于需要沉默的样品,r=1 r=1,用于准确的[静 输出,r=0 r=0 否则. 总体来说, r 的未加权平均值高于 0–100 的样本。 我们还报告每个子类的分数,每个判断的通过率,以及反应和沉默诊断. 补充材料详细介绍了评估人员、其指示和汇总情况。

blocks.en: Separate judgments distinguish a response that misses the request from a response that addresses the request but fails its requirements, which a holistic score cannot do.
blocks.zh: 单独的判决将错过请求的回复与满足请求但未能满足要求的回复区分开来,而整体分数是无法做到的。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Evaluated Models. We evaluate 30 omni-modal model configurations with native audio input, including 16 proprietary and 14 open-source configurations.
The proprietary group covers the Gemini Pro, Flash, and Flash-Lite series [ 4 , 10 , 9 , 12 , 11 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , the proprietary Qwen-Omni series [ 33 , 32 ] , and Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite/Mini [ 1 ] .
The open-source group covers the Qwen-Omni series [ 41 , 40 ] , Muse-Spark-Open [ 28 ] , MiMo-V2.5/V2.6 [ 39 , 31 ] , Nemotron3-Nano-Omni [ 6 ] , OmniVinci [ 43 ] , MiniCPM-o [ 5 , 42 ] , and video-SALMONN 2+ [ 36 ] .
Tab. 2 lists all configurations and their inference modes.
All proprietary models run in their default thinking mode.
blocks.zh:
评估模型。 我们评价30个具有本土音频输入的全方位模式配置,包括16个专有和14个开源配置.
专有集团涵盖双子座Pro,Flash,和Flash-Lite系列[4,10,9,12,11,13,14,15,16,17],专有的Quen-Omni系列[33,32],以及Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite/Mini[1].
开放源代码组涵盖Quen-Omni系列[41,40],Muse-Spark-Open [28],MiMo-V2.5/V2.6 [39,31],Nemotron3-Nano-Omni [6],OmniVinci [43],MiniCPM-o [5,42],以及视频-SALMONN 2+ [36].
Tab. 2 列出了所有配置及其推论模式.
所有专有模型都以默认思维模式运行.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We implement the evaluation with lmms-eval [ 45 ] .
All configurations use the same 1,000 samples, with each video and its original audio as input.
Open-source models run on 8–16 NVIDIA A800 GPUs.
We serve MiMo and Nemotron with vLLM [ 22 ] and Muse-Spark-Open with SGLang [ 46 ] .
Proprietary models are accessed through their APIs.
We score all responses with the protocol in Sec. 3.4 and use GPT-6-Luna [ 29 ] as the evaluator.
Model prompts, audiovisual preprocessing, and evaluator settings are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
执行详情。 我们用lmms-eval进行评估 [45].
所有配置都使用相同的1000个样本,每个视频及其原始音频作为输入.
开源模型运行于8–16 NVIDIA A800 GPU上.
我们为米莫和尼莫特龙服务 VLLM [22] 和Muse-Spark - Open 与SGLang [46].
自主模式通过它们的API访问.
我们用3.4号协议对所有答复进行评分,并使用GPT-6-Luna[29]作为评价者。
模型提示、视听预处理和评价器设置都在补充材料中。

blocks.zh: 4.2 主要调查结果

blocks.en:
Tab. 2 reports the scores on the 16 subcategories.
Fig. 4 shows the five category scores of selected models, and Fig. 5 shows their language, intent, and content pass rates.
blocks.zh:
标签2报告了16个子类的分数。
图4显示所选型号的5个类别分数,图5显示其语言,意向和内容通过率.

blocks.en:
Overall Performance. Gemini3.7-Flash leads the proprietary models with an Overall of 59.6.
Muse-Spark-Open leads the open-source models with 52.4, 7.2 points below Gemini3.7-Flash.
Within the Qwen3-Omni series, the thinking mode outperforms the instruct mode by 9.1 points.
The gain suggests that inferring the needed help from speech and the scene benefits from explicit reasoning.
blocks.zh:
总体性能. 双子座3.7-Flash领先专有型号,总体为59.6.
Muse-Spark-Open以52.4,7.2分低于双子座3.7-Flash领先开源模型.
在Qwen3-Omni系列中,思维模式比指示模式多出9.1分.
这一收益表明,从言论中推断出所需的帮助,而场景则从明确的推理中受益。

blocks.en:
Performance Across Categories. Request Integration and Response Deliberation are the most difficult categories.
One of the two categories scores lowest for 24 of the 30 configurations (Fig. 4 ).
Within Request Integration, 26 of the 30 configurations follow the order RRT > > MCI > > MPR.
Scores drop as a request extends from a spoken revision to nonverbal constraints and the needs of several people.
Within Response Deliberation, no configuration exceeds 44.6 on ESA, while the best DSR score is 75.0.
Judging whether the evidence supports an answer is much harder for current models than answering a direct request.
blocks.zh:
跨类别表现。 请求整合和反应审议是最困难的类别。
两个类别中有一个对30个配置中的24个组合(图4)的得分最低.
在请求集成中,30个配置中有26个遵循RRT > > MCI > 的命令. MPR (英语).
随着从口头修订到非语言限制和若干人的需求等请求的扩大,得分下降。
在 " 反应审议 " 中,欧空局的配置不超过44.6,而最佳DSR分数为75.0。
判断证据是否支持一个答案对于目前的模型来说比直接回答一个请求要难得多.

blocks.en:
Equal Overall scores can hide different strengths.
MiMo-V2.6-Flash and Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite both score 47.6.
MiMo-V2.6-Flash is higher than Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite on all three Response Deliberation subcategories.
Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite is higher on all three Situated Request Interpretation subcategories.
Category scores thus separate interpreting a request from adjusting the reply.
blocks.zh:
平等的整体分数可以隐藏不同优势.
米莫-V2.6-Flash和杜宝-Seed2.0-Lite均得分47.6.
MiMo-V2.6-Flash在所有三个反应审议子类上都比Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite高.
Doubao-Seed2.0-Lite在所有三个位置请求解释子类别中都较高.
因此,分类分数将解释请求与调整答复分开。

blocks.en:
Performance Across Evaluation Dimensions. Content is the main bottleneck (Fig. 5 ).
Gemini3.7-Flash, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, and Muse-Spark-Open all exceed 97% on language and 71% on intent, but none exceeds 43% on content.
These models mostly address the right request in the user’s language, yet their help often fails the scene facts or necessary constraints.
A higher intent pass rate does not imply a higher content pass rate.
Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash exceeds Gemini3.7-Flash by 4.6 points on intent but trails it by 10.1 points on content.
Identifying the valid request and satisfying it are thus separate abilities.
blocks.zh:
跨评价层面的业绩。 内容是主要瓶颈(图5).
双子座3.7-Flash,Quen3.8-Omni-Flash,以及Muse-Spark-Open在语言上都超过了97%,在意图上超过了71%,但在内容上都没有超过43%.
这些模型主要处理用户语言中的正确要求,然而他们的帮助往往没有现场事实或必要的限制.
更高的意向通过率并不意味着更高的内容通过率.
Quen3.8-Omni-Flash在意向上超过双子座3.7-Flash4.6分,但在内容上追踪到它10.1分.
因此,确定有效请求并满足其要求是不同的能力。

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis Of Response Tendency
blocks.zh: 4.3 对策分析

blocks.en:
Performance Across Languages. Fig. 6 compares Overall scores on the Chinese and English subsets.
We measure the gap with the Language Gap Index, LGI = ( S en − S zh ) / S × 100 % \mathrm{LGI}=(S_{\mathrm{en}}-S_{\mathrm{zh}})/S\times 100\% , where S en S_{\mathrm{en}} , S zh S_{\mathrm{zh}} , and S S are the Overall scores on the English subset, the Chinese subset, and the full set.
Except for the two Flash-Lite models, all proprietary models stay within ± \pm 11.2% LGI, which may reflect broad bilingual training data.
MiMo, Qwen3-Omni, and Muse-Spark-Open show similarly small gaps.
Large gaps concentrate in smaller models such as Qwen2.5-Omni, MiniCPM-o, and Nemotron3-Nano-Omni, which often fail to reply in Chinese.
Qwen2.5-Omni-7B passes 42.2% of language checks in Chinese and 96.8% in English.
blocks.zh:
跨语言表现。 图6 中文和英文子集的整体得分.
我们测量与语言差距指数,LGI=(S en-S zh)/S × 100%\mathrm{LGI}(S_{\mathrm{en}}-S_{\mathrm{zh}})/S\times 100\%,其中S en S_{\mathrm{en}},S mathrm{zh}},S为英文子集,中文子集,全集的总分数.
除了两个Flash-Lite模型外,所有专有模型都停留在±\pm 11.2%的LGI范围内,这可能反映广泛的双语培训数据.
MiMo,Qwen3-Omni,以及Muse-Spark-Open显示类似小的缺口.
巨大的缺口集中在较小的模型上,如Quen2.5-Omni,MiniCPM-o,以及Nemotron3-Nano-Omni,这些模型往往没有中文回复.
Wen2.5-Omni-7B通过42.2%的中文语言检查,96.8%的英语语言检查.

blocks.en:
Ability To Remain Silent. Silence accuracy rises with Overall for most models (Fig. 7 ).
Models that better understand spoken requests also better recognize when no response is needed.
Two exceptions stand out.
Models under 10B rarely output [SILENCE] , and none exceeds 22.1% silence accuracy.
video-SALMONN 2+ 72B outputs [SILENCE] on most samples, reaching 83.2% silence accuracy but only 9.6 Overall.
Its 7B version mostly describes the scene instead of answering the request.
The series is trained mainly for audiovisual captioning [ 36 ] , which may bias it toward scene description.
blocks.zh:
保持寂静的能力。 沉默精度随着大多数模型的总体变化而上升(图7)。
更好地理解口头请求的模式也更好地认识到在不需要答复时。
有两个例外。
10B以下的模型很少输出[SILENCE],也没有一个超过22.1%的静态精度.
视频-萨尔蒙 2+72B在大多数样本上的输出[静态],达到83.2%的静态精度,但总体只有9.6.
它的7B版本大多描述了场景而不是回应请求.
该系列培训主要针对视听字幕[36],可能偏向场景描述.

blocks.en:
Response Change Across Contrastive Pairs. Tab. 3 reports whether the response changes within contrastive pairs.
The top five configurations fully pass both samples in only 19.5% of the 147 pairs, close to the 19.0% expected if the two samples were answered independently.
Being correct under one condition thus does not make a model more likely to be correct under the other.
In the 47 pairs from MSA, AST, and CA, one sample requires a response and the other requires silence.
Always outputting [SILENCE] scores 50.0 on MSA, and 26 of the 30 configurations score lower.
Configurations with Overall below 36 keep the same decision in at least 78.7% of these pairs.
The top five keep the same decision in 8.4% of the AST pairs but 71.1% of the MSA pairs.
They fall silent once a request is withdrawn, yet still respond to peer conversations.
With nearly equal Overall scores, Gemini4-Argon keeps the same MSA decision in 27.8% of pairs and Gemini3.5-Flash in 88.9%.
blocks.zh:
《跨矛盾对等的反应变化》。 Tab. 3报告了对应对内的反应是否发生变化。
在147对样本中,前5个配置只通过19.5%的两种样本,如果两个样本得到独立回答,则接近预期的19.0%。
因此,在一个条件下正确并不使模型在另一个条件下更可能正确。
在来自MSA,AST和CA的47对中,一个样本需要反应,另一个则需要沉默.
总是输出[SILENCE]在MSA上得分50.0分,30个配置中有26个得分较低.
总体低于36的配置至少保留78.7%的这种组合。
前5名在8.4%的AST配对中保留同样的决定,但在管理事务协议配对中保留71.1%。
一旦请求被撤回,他们就会沉默,但仍对同行对话作出回应。
几乎一样 总体分数,双子座4-Argon保持了27.8%的对数和88.9%的双子座3.5-Flash的相同MSA决定.

blocks.en:
Input Modality Ablation. Fig. 8 compares two input changes with the native audio-video input. + Text Query appends the annotated target utterance as text. Audio → \rightarrow ASR replaces the audio with a timestamped transcript of all speech.
Of the 30 configurations, 27 improve with + Text Query and 21 with Audio → \rightarrow ASR .
blocks.zh:
输入模式障碍。 图8将两个输入变化与原声视频输入比较. + 键 文本查询附加注解的目标语句作为文本。 Audio ~\右旋 ASR 将音频替换为所有发言的时标记录.
在30个配置中,有27个用+文本查询改进,21个用Audio →\rightarrow ASR改进.

blocks.en:
+ Text Query spares a model from identifying the request in speech.
The weakest selected models gain the most, suggesting that request identification is their main bottleneck.
The strongest models change little, as they already identify most requests from speech.
blocks.zh:
+文本查询从语音中识别请求中省去了一个模型.
最弱的选定型号获得最多,说明请求识别是其主要瓶颈.
最强的模型变化不大,因为它们已经识别出大多数来自语音的请求.

blocks.en:
Audio → \rightarrow ASR makes the words explicit but drops acoustic cues such as emotion, intonation, speaker identity, and background sound.
The weakest models improve, suggesting that they poorly understand speech in raw audio.
The mid-ranked models decline, suggesting that the lost acoustic cues outweigh the benefit of explicit words.
The strongest models keep or improve their scores.
All of them run in thinking mode, which may help recover the request from the transcript and the video.
blocks.zh:
Audio →\rightarrow ASR 使单词清晰但会降低声调提示,如情感,内涵,扬声器身份,以及背景声音.
最弱的模型改进了,说明他们对原始音频中的语音理解不足.
排名中位的模型衰落,说明丢失的声调提示值超过了显性词的好处.
最强的模型保持或提高分数.
他们都以思维模式运行,这可能有助于从记录和视频中恢复请求.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We have introduced O-IN-Bench to evaluate whether omni-modal LLMs understand spoken intentions.
It keeps each request in native speech and the scene, and judges each response with a rubric verified against the video.
Our evaluation of 30 configurations suggests that the answer to the title question is not yet.
Current models do not always recognize complex requests, and they often keep responding when the speech is a conversation between peers rather than a request to the assistant.
Even after recognizing a request, they often fail to satisfy gestural constraints, the needs of several people, or the limits of the available evidence.
Recognizing a request and meeting its requirements are thus separate abilities, and an omni-modal assistant should treat the shared scene as part of the request.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了O-IN-Bench来评估所有模式的LLMs是否理解口头意图.
它把每个请求都保留在本地的演讲和场景中,并用一个与视频对照的标语来判断每个回复.
我们对30个配置的评价表明,标题问题的答案还没有。
目前的模型并不总是能识别复杂的请求,当演讲是同行之间的对话而不是对助手的请求时,他们往往会不断回应.
即使承认了某项请求,它们也往往无法满足基因限制、若干人的需求或现有证据的限度。
因此,承认一项请求并满足其要求是不同的能力,一个全方位模式助理应将共享场景作为请求的一部分。
